claims_checked.claim: Q3 2026 operating cash flow was $643 million and free cash flow was $472 million.
Nine-month operating cash flow was $1,072 million.
Net debt was $414 million at September 30, 2026.
Adjusted EBITDA excluding special items was $789 million.
Nine-month FCF is $596 million, calculated as $1,072 million operating cash less $476 million capital expenditure.
Nine-month dividends paid on Alcoa common stock were $80 million.
Average aluminum prices decreased 10 percent sequentially.
The AliGroup transaction remained unclosed and was targeted for the first half of 2027.
The notes raised $2.6 billion to fund the transaction.
The snapshot reports FY2025 FCF of $567 million.
The snapshot lists no dividend-family passes or adjusted_signal below strong_buy.
The transaction includes up to US$750 million contingent consideration and approximately US$1.2 billion rehabilitation provisions.
